text:
maria: Quick sync — we need a concrete plan for KV/prefix cache effectiveness signals so Console dashboards and Optimize can rely on them. Low-ish priority but needs to be ready before next rollout window.

ajay: +1. what are the minimal signals we all agree on? hit rate, eviction rate, reuse-by-workload?

maria: Yes. Minimal set I'd propose: `kv_cache_hit_ratio`, `kv_cache_evictions_total`, `prefix_cache_reuse_ratio`, and `kv_cache_size_bytes`. Also: `kv_cache_items_by_ttl` for eviction age patterns.

kevin: We should include labels: `model`, `route`, `tenant_id` (masked/hashed), `workload_type` (batch/interactive), and `seq_len_bucket`. Cardinality is a concern though.

ajay: For cardinality, suggestion: cap `tenant_id` to top N tenants + `_other`. We can also roll up by `route` only for the public dashboard.

elaine: We need concrete PromQL examples to instrument the dashboards. Otherwise console team will be blocked.

maria: Copying sample queries — feel free to tweak: 
``` 
# hit ratio (5m window)
(sum by(model, route) (increase(kv_cache_hits_total[5m]))) /
(sum by(model, route) (increase(kv_cache_hits_total[5m]) + increase(kv_cache_misses_total[5m])))
```

maria: And evictions: 
```
increase(kv_cache_evictions_total[1h])
```

kevin: For reuse-by-workload: we track `prefix_cache_prefix_reuse_total{workload_type="interactive"}` and then compute ratio vs `prefix_cache_prefix_lookups_total`. Example: 
```
sum by(model, route, workload_type) (increase(prefix_cache_prefix_reuse_total[1h])) /
max(1, sum by(model, route, workload_type) (increase(prefix_cache_prefix_lookups_total[1h])))
```

ajay: We should expose a sampled histogram of cache key cardinality per minute to detect explosion: `kv_cache_keycardinality_histogram` (buckets: 10,100,1k,10k). That can drive alerting.

elaine: UX/Console needs: 1) per-route top-N models using cache 2) time-series hitrate with rollback annotation 3) heatmap of reuse-by-workload 4) per-tenant drilldown (only for enterprise customers).

maria: Agree. Also include an annotation feed for rollouts: when model/route config changes, emit `kv_cache_rollout_annotation{route, model, rollout_id}` so dashboard panels can overlay.

storage-bot: Note: metric `kv_cache_hits_total` already exists on runtime edge, but with label set {shard, host}. We will add `model` and `route` labels but they will be populated at request routing time.

kevin: Good. We need a contract: runtime emits raw counters with labels `[model, route, workload_type, seq_len_bucket, tenant_bucket]`. Ingest pipeline will downsample to 1m and 5m rollups and compute ratios.

ajay: Can runtime folks commit to low-cardinality `tenant_bucket` (top 50) by next Thurs? If not, we need to handle in the metrics pipeline.

maria: Runtime owner @kevin? Can you confirm?

kevin: I can add the labels. We'll implement a `tenant_bucket` sticky-hash in router at request time. ETA: end of week for a canary.

elaine: On Console side, we'll start with a draft dashboard spec. Couple UI questions: should we show raw counts or ratio by default? ratio is friendlier but raw counts help troubleshoot.

maria: Default to ratio with a toggle to raw counts. Also include a panel that shows `requests_without_cache_label_total` so we can spot routes not instrumented.

ajay: Alerts: set critical if 15m hit_rate < 20% for top 5 routes or evictions spike > 3x baseline. Also alert on keycardinality buckets > threshold.

kevin: Implementation notes: avoid high-cardinality metrics on host/shard in the public ingest path. We'll emit host/shard only to internal Prom and not to long-term ingest.

maria: Ops: please add a roll-forward playbook in runbook: how to disable caching for a route if reuse drops dramatically.

elaine: I'll create a PR with the dashboard JSON and panel list. Assigning to @maria for review and @kevin for label contract.

maria: Action items:
- kevin: add labels + tenant_bucket sticky-hash (ETA Thu)
- ajay: write PromQL-based alert rules and runbook snippets (ETA Tue)
- elaine: draft dashboard + panel toggles (ETA Wed)
- storage-bot: confirm which existing metrics will be extended vs new (commented)

kevin: noted. I'll post a quick snippet of router changes once I open the canary PR.

storage-bot: linked runtime ticket IR-402 in infra. Will update when metrics schema is published.

maria: Great. If no objections, we'll lock the schema Monday and start onboarding dashboards. :shipit:

ajay: fine by me.

kevin: good to go.

elaine: cool, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
